outcome: prevalence of specific congenital heart defects
cohort: The study included 8,536,101 live births in Sao Paulo State, Brazil, from January 1, 2005, to December 31, 2018.
finding: Congenital heart disease (CHD) showed an increasing prevalence trend in recent years, with the highest rates found in Sao Paulo City and among mothers aged 35 years or older.
birth_weight: All birth weights were included; 74.4% of CHD cases weighed >2500g.
gest_age: All gestational ages were included; 75.2% of CHD cases were born at term.
